We are a passionate team of Computer Science Engineering students interested in technology, innovation, and problem-solving. Our team focuses on software development, programming, and exploring emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

Through NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we look forward to developing an impactful solution, exploring space-related challenges, and contributing our ideas towards a better future.
summary:
The Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map is an interactive, data-driven platform designed to support safer and smarter human exploration of Mars. It brings Martian geographical information, terrain visualization, environmental conditions, potential hazards, route-planning insights, mission information, and scientific discoveries together in one unified interface.

The platform transforms complex planetary information into accessible visual insights, helping users explore Martian regions, understand environmental challenges, and evaluate potential exploration routes. By utilizing NASA's free and open planetary datasets and relevant space agency partner data, the project aims to make Mars exploration information more understandable and useful for researchers, students, mission planners, and future explorers.

Our vision is to support informed decision-making and contribute to the future of sustainable human exploration beyond Earth.
details:
INTERPLANETARY SURVIVAL GUIDE: MARTIAN MAP

Problem Statement

Human exploration of Mars involves significant challenges, including unfamiliar terrain, extreme environmental conditions, potential hazards, and limited accessibility to complex planetary information. Understanding these challenges is essential for planning safer exploration missions.

Proposed Solution

We propose an interactive Martian exploration and survival guide that consolidates geographical, environmental, hazard, mission, and scientific information into one platform. It helps users explore Mars and understand important factors that could influence future exploration decisions.

Key Features

  • Interactive Martian geographical map
  • Multiple terrain and map visualization layers
  • Environmental information and analysis
  • Potential hazard visualization
  • Exploration route-planning functionality
  • Mars mission information
  • Scientific discoveries and research information
  • Survival-oriented decision-support insights

Technology Stack

Frontend: React.js, Vite, HTML, CSS, JavaScript

Backend: Python, FastAPI

Data Processing: Python-based data processing and JSON datasets

Visualization: Interactive map and geographical data visualization

Deployment: Vercel frontend and separately hosted FastAPI backend

NASA Open Data Contribution

NASA's free and open planetary datasets provide the scientific foundation for exploring Martian geography and environmental information. Relevant Space Agency Partner datasets can further enhance the platform's planetary exploration capabilities.

Target Users

  • Space researchers and scientists
  • Future Mars mission planners
  • Students and educators
  • Planetary exploration enthusiasts
  • Space technology developers

Expected Impact

The platform aims to improve access to Martian exploration information, simplify the understanding of planetary conditions, and support informed exploration planning.

Future Scope

  • Integration of additional NASA planetary datasets
  • Advanced AI-assisted hazard analysis
  • Improved terrain and elevation visualization
  • More advanced route optimization
  • Personalized astronaut survival recommendations
  • Expansion to other planetary exploration environments

Vision

To transform planetary data into actionable intelligence and help make humanity's journey beyond Earth safer, smarter, and more sustainable.
